Sasha: Quick notewe're seeing a locale-specific regression on aurora-lite int4 during bring-up. JA/KO BLEU down ~4 pts vs fp16; outputs sometimes include invisible chars near small kana clusters.

Hiro: Can you paste a tiny repro and one failing sample?

Sasha: Repro: `python eval.py --model aurora-lite-q5-int4 --dataset wmt-ja-en-kor --split test --samples 300`
Sample diff:
FP16-detok: "...あやちゃん。"
INT4-detok: "...あや�や�ちゃん。"

Marta: Tokenizer pre-merge outputs match, so likely generation/postprocess divergence. Could be kernel ordering or kvcache rounding.

Tian: I'll run a 2-axis bisect (kernel order x kvcache-precision) on dev pool and log token traces.

eval-bot: Queued bisect run: bisect-6942-a1. Will post diffs.

Hiro: Add a detok smoke assert (fail on ZWSP/ZWJ/null) and promote a 200-sample kana+ruby promptset to high-sensitivity alerts.

Marta: On it, pushing alert rule now.

Sasha: Owners: Tian (bisect), Marta (alerts), Hiro (postproc audit). Holding int4 canary for subtitle routes until resolved.

Tian: First pass shows kernel-order variant B reproduces the invisible insertions; variant A matches fp16. Posting full trace when ready.

Sasha: Great, thanks. Will wait for final bisect and then decide rollback vs patch. :thumbsup:
